problem_statement: We want to understand what factors influence delivery delays in our global logistics operations. Our operations team needs data-driven insights into which operational metrics, regional factors, and carrier choices are most predictive of late deliveries. We need to identify opportunities to improve on-time delivery performance, reduce costs, and optimize carrier partnerships. The analysis should account for weather patterns, vehicle types, plant locations, and customer priorities.
audience: Operations Manager, Finance Director, Supply Chain Executive
success_metric: Identify top 5 factors correlated with delivery delays with statistical confidence. Provide segmented recommendations by region, carrier, and priority level. Quantify impact on operational costs.
data_dictionary: delivery_operations_complex.csv contains 205 order records with data quality issues (missing values, outliers, duplicates) to test pipeline robustness. Columns: order_id (identifier), customer_name (categorical, PII-like), customer_email (contact, PII, 10% missing), order_date (temporal), plant (4 plants: A-D), region (5 regions: US East/West, EU Central/West, APAC), carrier (4 carriers: X-Z, W), product_category (Engine, Chassis, Electrical, Interior, Suspension), planned_delivery_days (2-8 days), actual_delivery_days (1-12 days, includes impossible value: -1), units_shipped (50-500, 5% missing), shipping_cost_usd (500-50K with 10x outliers, 3% missing), priority_flag (Low, Medium, High, Critical), weather_delay (0/1/missing), vehicle_type (Truck/Van/Air/Rail, 5% missing), avg_temp_celsius (-10 to 40C), humidity_pct (20-95%, includes impossible value: 150), late_delivery (boolean target, derived from planned vs actual days)

stress_test_features: Missing values (60 cells) - tests handling of incomplete data
Outliers in shipping_cost (10x multiplier) - tests outlier detection
Impossible values (negative days, >100% humidity) - tests data validation
PII-like columns (customer_name, customer_email) - tests PII detection
Multiple potential targets (weather_delay, late_delivery, priority classification) - tests target scoring
Mixed data types (numeric, categorical, temporal, boolean) - tests type handling
High cardinality regions & carriers - tests categorical scaling
Missing target column values would require user clarification
expected_issues_to_catch: Data quality warnings (duplicates, impossible values, high missingness)
PII flag for customer_name and customer_email
Multiple target candidates scored (late_delivery should rank highest)
Sample rows showing outliers and edge cases
Recommendations for data cleaning before analysis
